csv_project_name: AE Services for LCHS Stadium Bleachers & Lighting Replace
csv_scope_of_work: The La Ca ada Unified School District is inviting qualified architectural and engineering firms, to provide architectural & engineering and associated planning services to the District on stadium bleachers replacement project at its La Ca ada High School ( LCHS ) campus. This project would replace the 2800 seats home side aluminum bleachers at the stadium. Project also includes replacement of stadium lights, restroom upgrade and other ADA accessibility requirement, and potential expansion of expansion of existing field house or construction of new field house. Scope of services as described in the Agreement includes: Site investigations & document search & review Conceptual Design Schematic Design Design Development Agency Coordination & Review Construction Documents DSA Submittal & Review Bidding & Contracting Construction Administration
